description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between computational cost, measured in TFLOPs (trillion floating-point operations) on the x-axis, and model efficiency, represented as Loss Ratio (%) on the y-axis, for different configurations of the SepLLM model compared to a Vanilla baseline. The x-axis spans from 1e7 to 9e8 TFLOPs using a logarithmic scale with major tick marks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis ranges from 94% to 100% Loss Ratio on a linear scale, with grid lines and tick labels at 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. Five distinct lines are plotted: the purple line with triangle markers labeled “Vanilla” remains relatively flat near 100% across the entire TFLOP range; the orange line with square markers, “SepLLM (n=128),” starts at approximately 98.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to about 99.8% by 5e7 TFLOPs, and then plateaus near 100%; the blue line with cross markers, “SepLLM (n=64, H),” begins at ~97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases sharply to ~99.5% by 2e7 TFLOPs, and then stabilizes near 100%; the green line with diamond markers, “SepLLM (n=64, H/T),” starts at ~97.8% at 1e7 TFLOPs, climbs steadily to ~99.8% by 3e8 TFLOPs, and continues rising slightly beyond; the red line with circle markers, “SepLLM (n=64),” begins at ~94.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs, jumps to ~95.8% at 2e7 TFLOPs, reaches ~99.2% by 2e8 TFLOPs, peaks at ~100% around 4e8 TFLOPs, dips slightly to ~99.8% at 5e8 TFLOPs, and then recovers to ~100% by 7e8 TFLOPs. All lines show increasing or stable Loss Ratio with higher TFLOPs, indicating improved efficiency with greater computation, with the red line exhibiting the most dynamic behavior.
